description: Wind resource at a coordinate from NASA POWER (MERRA-2 based 25-year climatology, ~0.5° grid): annual and monthly mean wind speed at 10 m and 50 m, prevailing direction at 50 m, the shear exponent between them, an extrapolated mean speed at your hub height and an estimated mean power density (Rayleigh distribution, air density 1.225 kg/m³). Coarse screening data; the Global Wind Atlas 250 m layers have no public point API. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

hubHeight.description: Hub height in metres for the extrapolated speed, 10 to 250 (default 100)
